# netbox_custom_field (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/customization/custom-fields/#custom-fields):

> Each model in NetBox is represented in the database as a discrete table, and each attribute of a model exists as a column within its table. For example, sites are stored in the dcim_site table, which has columns named name, facility, physical_address, and so on. As new attributes are added to objects throughout the development of NetBox, tables are expanded to include new rows.
>
> However, some users might want to store additional object attributes that are somewhat esoteric in nature, and that would not make sense to include in the core NetBox database schema. For instance, suppose your organization needs to associate each device with a ticket number correlating it with an internal support system record. This is certainly a legitimate use for NetBox, but it's not a common enough need to warrant including a field for every NetBox installation. Instead, you can create a custom field to hold this data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_custom_field" "test" {
  name             = "test"
  type             = "text"
  content_types    = ["virtualization.vminterface"]
  weight           = 100
  validation_regex = "^.*$"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_types` (Set of String) The object types the custom field applies to.
- `name` (String) The name of the custom field.
- `type` (String) The type of the custom field.

### Optional

- `choice_set_id` (Number) The ID of the choice set associated with the custom field.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the custom field.
- `default` (String) The default value of the custom field.
- `description` (String) A description of the custom field.
- `filter_logic` (String) One of [disabled, loose, exact].
- `group_name` (String) The group the custom field is shown in.
- `is_cloneable` (Boolean) Replicate this value when cloning objects.
- `label` (String) The label of the custom field.
- `nulls_first` (Boolean) Sort null values before non-null values when ordering by this field. Needs NetBox 4.7.0 or later.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the custom field. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `related_object_filter` (String) Filter the object choices of the custom field with a JSON object of query parameters. This is best managed through the use of `jsonencode`.
- `related_object_type` (String) The related object type of the custom field.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether a value is required for the custom field.
- `search_weight` (Number) Weighting for search. Lower values are considered more important. Fields with a search weight of zero will be ignored.
- `ui_editable` (String) One of [yes, no, hidden].
- `ui_visible` (String) One of [always, if-set, hidden].
- `unique` (Boolean) The value of this field must be unique for the assigned object.
- `validation_maximum` (Number) The maximum allowed value.
- `validation_minimum` (Number) The minimum allowed value.
- `validation_regex` (String) A regular expression that values must match.
- `validation_schema` (String) A JSON schema that the value of the custom field is validated against. This is best managed through the use of `jsonencode`. Needs NetBox 4.6.0 or later.
- `weight` (Number) The weight of the custom field. Defaults to `100`.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the custom field was created.
- `data_type` (String) The data type of the custom field.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the custom field was last changed.
- `status` (String) The status of the custom field.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_custom_field.example 1
```
